app.title: Hot Air Dryer HMI
why.norecipe: Send a recipe to the dryer first
why.runningrecipe: Cannot change the recipe while running
why.applying: A recipe is already being sent
why.notapplied: The dryer did not confirm the recipe, so it was not applied
why.stopnotsent: The dryer did not confirm the stop command (communication may be lost). Stop it at the machine.
why.overtrip: Must be below the high-temperature stop ({0:0} ℃)
why.notsent: The dryer did not confirm the change, so it was not applied
val.steps: There must be three steps: preheat, dry, cool
val.steptemp: {0} temperature must be at least 20℃ and below the high temperature stop ({1:0}℃)
val.poll: Poll interval must be at least 100 ms
val.timeout: Comm loss time must be longer than the poll interval
val.warntrip: High temp warning must be below high temp stop
val.trend: Trend points must be at least 60
val.language: Language must be en or ko
